LESSON: PARABLE ON PRAYER MIDNIGHT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life and Ministry of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.3: Parable on prayer Midnight

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Parable on prayer Midnight
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how they pray daily. 1. Why should Christians pray at all times?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life
2. appreciate the parable by praying to God always

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life

Teach
• Today’s focus: apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life” using a school example.
• Model B for “apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate the parable by praying to God always

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the parable by praying to God always.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the parable by praying to God always” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the parable by praying to God always” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the parable by praying to God always" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life
• Model 2: appreciate the parable by praying to God always

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life
2. Practise: appreciate the parable by praying to God always

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Parable on prayer Midnight.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how they pray daily. 1. Why should Christians pray at all times?
2. How do you exercise faith in God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life
• appreciate the parable by praying to God always

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
